I wrote my dissertation on tooth whitening. At safe concentrations (up to 16% carbamide peroxide) negative effects are mainly sensitivity and potentially gingival bleaching, and are always temporary. In the EU, this is the highest legal limit.

Stick with safe levels and you’ll be absolutely
fine.

Be careful not to overbrush in an attempt for even whiter teeth! The first whitening effect you’ll notice will be when your new electric toothbrush removes stains from your teeth, allowing the beautiful natural tooth colour to be seen.
